tenfold_analysis: A tenfold corpus would increase same-host queueing and per-document artifact storage. The offline evaluator loads selected articles and reference tokens, and computes eight tables. Memory and CPU capacity at tenfold size are not measured. The 15 GiB capture guard refuses a new capture below the floor; it is not a throughput or crash-recovery guarantee. Larger loads require a separate scale benchmark and a new declared recipe before adoption.
